data.assessment: Company A is the worst-off company, with an on-time rate of 0.84 and 7.8 late deliveries, all from missed pickups. A never parks on the road, yet it absorbs 1352 s of the town's 2404 blocked seconds. B and C wait on the road about 38–40 times each, and C pays most of the sanctions (14.8). Release overstays (23.0) dominate the violations, but the blocking guard evicted only 2.8 times. So robots parked at the central node are slowing A's pickups, while the town-wide on-time count of 121.8 out of 132.2 is otherwise healthy, with nothing unfinished.

proposals.title: Tighten the blocking guard: evict a parked robot when 2 robots wait behind it (block_k 3 -> 2)
proposals.rationale: A's 1352 blocked seconds and 7.8 pickup deadline misses, against only 2.8 blocking-guard evictions, suggest parked B and C robots stay at the hub too long while others queue behind them. Evicting at 2 waiting robots should cut blocked_s, raise A's on-time rate (the floor) and add a few on-time deliveries town-wide, with C already at 1.00 and little to lose. A should vote yes. C, and possibly B, may vote no because each eviction is a Major sanction (1.5 points) that lowers their utility, so the quorum of 2 is uncertain.
proposals.cadl:
# =====================================================================
# robot_town.cadl ─── ロボットの街：3 社の配送ロボットが道路を共有する
#
# 道路網はラズパイマウスのシミュレータと同じ 11 ノード・17 エッジ。
# 3 社（A / B / C）が 2 台ずつロボットを走らせ、ノードは 1 台ずつしか
# 使えない。仕事のないロボットは車庫に戻るか、道路上（中央の交差点 8）
# に止まって次の注文を待つ。止まったロボットは他社の通行をふさぐ。
#
# `# @amend:<名前>` が付いた行は、改正してよいパラメータ。どの層（規則・
# 契約）に属し、どこまで動かしてよいかは constitution.yaml が決める。
# 委員会（COUNCIL）が自分で改正できるのは規則の層だけで、契約の層を
# 変えるには人間の判断が要る。
# =====================================================================

sos:
  name: "RobotTown"
  type: Collaborative             # 独立した 3 社が共通の規則を決める
  version: "1.0.0"

  context:
    environment:
      num_robots:   6
      num_companies: 3
      time_step_ms: 1000

  actors:
    - id: TOWN_STEWARD
      role: "road_steward"
      autonomy: low
      capabilities: [assign_order, record_violation, evict]
      interface:
        input:  [order_request, position_report, node_released, rule_update]
        output: [order_assignment, eviction_notice, regime_notice, violation_report]

    - id: "ROBOT[1..N]"
      role: "delivery_robot"
      autonomy: high
      capabilities: [move, park, pickup, dropoff]
      interface:
        input:  [order_assignment, eviction_notice, regime_notice, amendment_proposal]
        output: [position_report, node_released, ballot]

    - id: COUNCIL
      role: "rule_amendment_body"
      autonomy: medium
      capabilities: [propose_amendment, tally_ballots]
      interface:
        input:  [violation_report, ballot]
        output: [amendment_proposal, rule_update]

  contracts:
    # ── 顧客への約束：注文 1 件ごとのインスタンス（契約の層。人間が決める） ──
    - id: DELIVERY_SLA
      parties: [TOWN_STEWARD, "ROBOT[*]"]
      guarantee:
        - "pickup_time <= 120s"         # @amend:pickup_deadline
        - "dropoff_time <= 120s"        # @amend:dropoff_deadline
      lifecycle:
        states: [Assigned, PickedUp, Delivered, Late]
        initial: Assigned
        terminal: [Delivered, Late]
        transitions:
          - id: pickup
            from: Assigned
            to:   PickedUp
            on:   "ROBOT[i].status == PickedUp"
            deadline: 120s            # @amend:pickup_deadline
            on_violation: { transition: Late, severity: Major }
          - id: dropoff
            from: PickedUp
            to:   Delivered
            on:   "ROBOT[i].status == Delivered"
            deadline: 120s            # @amend:dropoff_deadline
            on_violation: { transition: Late, severity: Major }

    # ── 道路の使い方：道路上に止まるたびに 1 インスタンス ──
    - id: ROAD_USE
      parties: [TOWN_STEWARD, "ROBOT[*]", COUNCIL]
      guarantee:
        - "hold_time <= hold_limit"
      authority:
        decision_holder: COUNCIL
        beta: 0.5
        mode: "collective"
      information:
        alpha: 1.0                    # 規則と違反記録は全社に公開
      incentives:
        type: sanction
        lambda: 0.5                   # @amend:sanction_lambda
        rules:
          - "penalty(ROBOT[i], lambda) when overstay"
      lifecycle:
        states: [Holding, Overstay, Released, Evicted]
        initial: Holding
        terminal: [Released, Evicted]
        transitions:
          - id: release
            from: [Holding, Overstay]
            to:   Released
            on:   "ROBOT[i] -> TOWN_STEWARD : node_released"
            deadline: 60s             # @amend:hold_limit
            on_violation: { transition: Overstay, severity: Minor }
      monitors:
        - id: blocking_guard
          observe: "ROBOT[i].blocking"
          sampling: periodic(1000ms)
          rule: "ROBOT.blocking >= 2 AND state IN [Holding, Overstay]"  # @amend:block_k
          on_match: { transition: Evicted, severity: Major }

  # ── 運用モード：分散（各社が道路上で待つ）⇄ 集中（管理者が待避所を割り当てる） ──
  # 条件は 5 分ごとに、直前 5 分の観測で判定する。
  #   orders_in_window : 3 社の注文の合計件数
  #   blocked_pct      : ロボットが止まっているロボットにふさがれていた時間の割合（%）
  # 集中管理は交差点をふさがれない反面、エッジを 1 台ずつ割り当てるので、
  # 注文が非常に多いと許可待ちが積み重なる。そのときだけ分散に戻す。
  transitions:
    - from: DISTRIBUTED
      to: CENTRALIZED
      condition: "orders_in_window < 22"      # @amend:to_central
      protocol: SWITCH
      safety_invariant: "robots_on_road == 0"
    - from: CENTRALIZED
      to: DISTRIBUTED
      condition: "orders_in_window >= 26"     # @amend:to_distributed
      protocol: SWITCH

  protocols:
    - id: SWITCH
      trigger: "regime_condition_holds"
      steps:
        - "TOWN_STEWARD -> ROBOT[*] : regime_notice"
        - "ROBOT[*] -> TOWN_STEWARD : node_released"
        - "TOWN_STEWARD : activate_regime"
    - id: AMEND
      trigger: "period_end"
      steps:
        - "TOWN_STEWARD -> COUNCIL : violation_report"
        - "COUNCIL -> ROBOT[*] : amendment_proposal"
        - "ROBOT[*] -> COUNCIL : ballot"
        - "COUNCIL : tally_ballots"
        - "COUNCIL -> TOWN_STEWARD : rule_update"

  metrics:
    - id: on_time_deliveries
      formula: "count(Delivered)"
      target: ">= 0.9 * count(orders)"
    - id: blocked_time
      formula: "sum(blocked_robot_seconds)"
      target: "<= 600s"
assumptions: A's pickup misses are caused mainly by B and C robots parked at the central node.
An eviction actually frees the node quickly enough to help the queued robot meet its pickup deadline.
Evicted robots can still reach their next pickup on time, so C's on-time rate does not drop much.
unknowns: Whether B and C change their parking behaviour in response to more Major sanctions.
How often exactly two robots queue behind a parked robot, i.e. how many extra evictions this triggers.
Whether the on-time gain clears min_improvement of 1.0.

predictions.subject: metric:blocked_s
predictions.note: Parked robots are removed earlier when others queue behind them.

predictions.subject: metric:on_time_deliveries
predictions.note: Mainly from fewer pickup deadline misses at A.

predictions.subject: metric:min_company_on_time_rate
predictions.note: A is the floor and the main victim of blocking.

predictions.subject: metric:sanction_total
predictions.note: More Major eviction sanctions on robots that park on the road.

predictions.subject: vote:A
predictions.note: A has no sanctions and gains on-time deliveries.

predictions.subject: vote:B
predictions.note: Uncertain. B also suffers 849 blocked seconds, which may offset its extra sanctions.

predictions.subject: vote:C
predictions.note: C already delivers 1.00 on time, so added eviction sanctions lower its utility.

proposals.title: Shorten the allowed hold time on the road (hold_limit 60 s -> 50 s)
proposals.rationale: Release overstays are the largest violation cause (23.0), and A, which never parks, loses 1352 s to blocking. A shorter hold limit raises the cost of parking at the hub and may push B and C robots off the road sooner, reducing blocked_s and A's pickup misses. The on-time effect is less direct than the block_k option because overstay only adds a Minor sanction rather than forcing a release. A would vote yes, but B and C will likely vote no because their sanctions rise. This option is likely to be decided by the quorum.
